rita (sdk): Hey all — hitting a weird one with embeddings + rerank in the sample app. JS SDK returns embedding length 1536, Python client expects 2048 so downstream rerpank fails. Full response snippet below.

rita (sdk): Response from /v1/embeddings (JS SDK):
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-embed-s1",
  "embedding": [0.001, 0.23, ...],
  "meta": { "version": "2026-03-01" }
}
```

rita (sdk): But python client is doing `len(vec) == 2048` and erroring out. Also rerank endpoint is now returning scores array separate from items which broke our small local reranker.

jorge (ml infra): Which SDK versions? any custom quantization/quant model in play?

rita (sdk): JS sdk @ 0.9.3, py sdk @ 0.10.0. Model pinned to redwood-embed-s1:2026-03-01. No quantization on our side. Happens on hosted and dedicated.

sam (devex): I suspect two independent issues: 1) embedding dim should be read from response not assumed by client; 2) rerank shape change is a breaking response format. We should make SDKs tolerant.

sam (devex): Quick workaround for now (JS):
```js
// normalizeEmbedding.js
function normalize(v, expected = 2048) {
  if (v.length === expected) return v;
  if (v.length < expected) return v.concat(new Array(expected - v.length).fill(0));
  return v.slice(0, expected);
}
```
Use until SDK patch lands.

alex (eng-runtime): Re: rerank — we rolled out a shape change to return `{ items: [...], scores: [...] }` to make batching metadata explicit. Old shape was `[{id,score,doc}]`. That obviously breaks clients. We can add a compatibility flag `legacy_shape=true` on the rerank endpoint. Patch incoming.

rita (sdk): Thanks. For embeddings though, the server already returns `embedding.length` but JS SDK was ignoring it and coercing to the model profile. Py SDK still validates against model profile. Suggest both SDKs read the vector length from the payload and only validate if model provides an explicit `expected_dim` field.

jorge (ml infra): Agree. Also we should add a response field `embedding_dim` at top-level for clarity (and include in model catalog). I'll file infra ticket.

sam (devex): Proposed immediate plan:
- add `embedding_dim` to response (infra)
- make both SDKs accept dynamic dims (devex/sdk)
- add `legacy_shape` param to rerank and emit deprecation warning in response header (runtime)
- add integration test in sample-app repo to catch mismatch (devex)

ci-bot: New PR opened by alex: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pulls/2147 (adds legacy_shape param)

rita (sdk): I'll add a small non-breaking change to JS + Py to read `embedding.length`/`embedding_dim`. Will put up PR this afternoon.

sam (devex): Can we also improve auth retry behavior? I noticed when token expires the SDK returns 401 and doesn't attempt a token refresh for people using ephemeral tokens in sample apps. That's causing noisy errors during onboarding.

rita (sdk): Right now SDK has a single automatic retry on 429/5xx but not on 401. We should surface a hook `onAuthFailure` so app can provide refresh logic without SDK guessing.

alex (eng-runtime): We can add richer retry metadata in response headers so SDK can decide whether to retry. Also will add `x-rw-retryable: auth-refresh` header for 401s where refresh is safe.

jorge (ml infra): Small note: for embeddings the dimension mismatch can also happen when using model aliases that map to different checkpoints (we changed default taper in one alias). We should pin model version in sample apps.

sam (devex): OK owners: infra -> jorge to add embedding_dim; runtime -> alex to add legacy_shape param and header; sdk -> rita to accept vector length + onAuthFailure hook. I'll update the sample-app integration test.

rita (sdk): assigning self. PR will include migration guide and code snippets for users.

sam (devex): Thanks — let's aim to have the compatibility fixes in next minor release. I'll post follow-ups once PRs are green. :thumbsup:
